title: L1 · 201-bp01 · 步驟 1 軀干
_doc: Two 15-hole beams run PARALLEL (far and near). Two L-mounts join BOTH of them to the blue 7-hole beam, which is PERPENDICULAR and sits on top at one end. Two pins sit in holes 2 and 4 of the near beam, facing the other beam. Units: one hole = 1 (8 mm); hole i is centred at i-0.5.

steps.label: 步驟 1：兩條 15 孔樑並排 + 兩個 L 形連接件
步驟 1（續）：藍色 7 孔樑（與兩樑成直角）、第 2 與第 4 孔插銷
